study.question: Does the loss from whole-history concentration pooling arise from mixing own-target matches with unmatched identities, or from losing concentration localization by the other field? Can deterministic matched-field summaries and own-target-excluded pooling reduce measured cost while retaining utility?
study.hypothesis: Observed round19 local AUC0.6203373142 versus global0.6200928406 and pooled0.6197456744 leaves the reason for pooling loss unresolved. Global inference17.6174s versus local18.4469s suggests an efficiency opportunity, while wall499.144s versus507.906s is only1.73% lower and is not established savings. Source inspection shows category in category-matched groups and brand in brand-matched groups is constant; these distributions need no hash table. After exact structural elision, a single distribution over each field unmatched to its own target may preserve sufficient residual diversity without conditioning on the opposite field. This is a prospective implementation hypothesis; local means from the first512 rows are neither population evidence nor proof. The frozen joint_identity AUC0.6204259428 remains the utility anchor.

nearest_work.difference: Inherits the complete shallow predictor, parameter initialization and fine recency. New computational candidate removes constant distributions; new information replacement pools only unmatched identities, while retaining matched constants and local supports.

Prior global broadcast mixed matched and unmatched identities and lost all group assignment; prior pooled averaged all six coordinates across every group. Current intervention preserves own-field match exclusion; its pooled control operates per field only over unmatched groups and forms product coordinates afterward. No claim that older pooled and current pooled differ by a single factor.

DIN supplies target-conditioned learned interest activation and discusses the bottleneck of global pooling. We use fixed target equality groups and nonlearned empirical concentration. Supplied baseline is only DIN-style: it uses normalized softmax whereas inspected DIN lines272-274 relax normalization. No exact author-code reproduction or priority claim.

Author README verifies category, brand and action fields with no item identity. Full paper is unavailable through this source, so detailed DMR mechanisms remain unverified; no substitution of category-brand pairs for unavailable items is asserted.

Source winner summaries concern conversion and richer multi-domain histories. No contextual transport, learned token allocation, query generation, cross-domain gate or FM highway is adopted. Fixed-budget hashing here counts nonlearned identity frequencies; it is inherited, not transferred learned-embedding compression.

inherited_components: Static field embeddings and MLP; no new labels, embeddings, optimizer or loss
Local complete-pair count supports and product-of-marginal identity coordinates
Four true target-match groups and observed action/coarse-age histograms
Fine log2-age recency summaries with normalized log1p-count weighting
Fixed256-bin deterministic salt0 hash, entropy and with-replacement collision
Bias-free28x16x1 residual head, zero-initialized final layer
All host data construction, scoring, checkpointing, resource and seed contracts
study.proposed_difference: Analytically reconstruct constant matched-field distributions; compare exact two-group-per-field computation with one own-target-excluded unmatched distribution per field and a count-weighted unmatched pooled control. This separates a redundant computation from a new sufficiency hypothesis and from merging artifacts. No broad novelty claim; nearest prior local code contains most components and the external literature search is not exhaustive.
predictions: Structural identity coordinates agree with the original sketch to max absolute2e-6 and dense hashed equality-count oracle; same-checkpoint head agrees to2e-5. Allocation order and parameter count are exactly preserved.
target_excluded allocates256 bucket cells per field, structural_local and excluded_pooled512, original local_replay1024. This predicts less histogram reduction work, not measured end-to-end savings.

If own-target exclusion is sufficient, target_excluded satisfies the prospective retention and >=3% measured cost thresholds; if opposite-field stratification matters, structural_local beats both unmatched pooled replacements across paired seeds.

A same-base synthetic localization witness has nonzero structural difference but zero excluded and pooled difference. A cross-group-overlap witness has nonzero excluded difference but zero structural and pooled difference. Witnesses establish algebraic distinctions only.
falsifiers: Any oracle error above tolerance, nonfinite logit/diagnostic, nonzero empty-history identity, padding or reversal violation invalidates the affected implementation comparison. Retain failed receipts and costs.

An AUC loss>0.0002 or Logloss increase>0.0002 against either local_replay or frozen joint_identity fails provisional utility retention; intervals crossing the margin after repetitions leave retention unresolved.
Less than3% measured training wall and inference-time benefit against local_replay fails the declared efficiency objective even if bucket storage shrinks. One timing observation remains preliminary.

If pooled preserves utility, the necessity of opposite-field concentration localization is unsupported; if excluded differs from pooled, merging or estimator changes remain alternatives rather than proof of an event-binding mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed initialization, selected checkpoint, adaptive validation reuse and runtime variability
Hash collisions, reduced feature rank or regularization rather than information sufficiency
Product-of-replaced-marginals changes compound coordinates even when individual means are preserved
Dominance of the neither-match group and sparse rare-action slices; inspect counts before slice claims
Unverified static snapshot as-of dates limit point-in-time production interpretation; current supplied history is capped128 and only category/brand/action/time exist
Previous compact-capacity, recency factorization, action factorization, sketch-size/salt and entropy/collision-removal trajectories are mixed or negative, so no global monotonic compression claim
